goal: Prevent Tor peers from being misclassified by IP and inheriting whitelist permissions
Require a dedicated onion bind address when automatic Tor onion service listening is enabled
agreement: Contested objection: upgrade will fail startup for nodes with existing single-bind configs (sedited)
Suggests binding internal port+1 automatically with a warning instead of failing startup (sedited)
Support with code review and testing on FreeBSD (winterrdog, vasild, jpk68, jeanpablojp)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents inbound Tor connections from inheriting IP whitelist permissions
Eliminates misclassification of onion peers sharing regular P2P bind addresses
